decisions.reason: As a direct extension of the firm's core pipeline and valve-related offering, it fits existing customers and capabilities well and is therefore likely to remain in the range.

Although it uses the firm's metalworking and coating capabilities, a public waste bin is relatively far from its core infrastructure product line and is likely to be deprioritized in favor of core products.
The waste bin with ashtray has some municipal customer overlap but remains a non-core diversification product with weaker strategic fit than pipeline components and fittings.
Outdoor public ashtrays are the most peripheral and narrow of the diversification products, making them the most likely to be discontinued as resources are refocused on the established business.
